description: This file defines a WorktreeManager class for managing git worktrees associated with agent sessions, including creation, discovery, staging, committing, and cleanup of worktrees stored in a specific directory. It also includes utility functions and error handling related to git worktrees.

classes.name: WorktreeError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling worktree-related errors with specific error codes.

classes.name: WorktreeManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing git worktrees, including creation, discovery, staging, committing, and removal, with support for session IDs and git configuration adjustments.

methods.name: generateBranchName
methods.description: Generates a sanitized git branch name from a prompt string, appending a timestamp.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.createWorktree
methods.description: Creates a new git worktree, optionally from an existing branch or with a generated branch name.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.stageAllChanges
methods.description: Stages all changes in a specified worktree and returns whether there are staged changes.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.hasStagedChanges
methods.description: Checks if a worktree has staged changes.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.commitStagedChanges
methods.description: Commits staged changes in a worktree with a provided message.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.commitChanges
methods.description: Stages and commits all changes in a worktree, with optional commit message.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.removeWorktree
methods.description: Removes a worktree, with fallback to force removal if initial removal fails.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.discoverWorktrees
methods.description: Discovers existing worktrees in the designated directory.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.getWorktreeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific worktree directory.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.getWorktreeDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff between a worktree's HEAD and its parent branch.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.writeSessionId
methods.description: Writes a session ID to a worktree's session-id file and updates git exclude settings.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.readSessionId
methods.description: Reads the session ID from a worktree's session-id file.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.removeSessionId
methods.description: Removes the session-id file from a worktree.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.ensureWorktreeGitExclude
methods.description: Ensures the worktree's .gitignore is configured to exclude the session directory.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.ensureWorktreesDir
methods.description: Ensures the worktrees directory exists.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.ensureGitExclude
methods.description: Ensures the main repository's exclude file includes the worktrees directory.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.resolveGitDir
methods.description: Resolves the main git directory, handling worktree configurations.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.isValidWorktree
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a valid git worktree.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Retrieves the current branch name.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.branchExists
methods.description: Checks if a branch exists in the repository.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.getDefaultBranch
methods.description: Detects the default branch of the repository, trying remote HEAD, then main/master.

methods.name: WorktreeManager.log
methods.description: Logs messages to the output channel.
